h:
CivitAI 删除了包含工作流程的图像元数据，因此我决定发布我的 SD1.5 和 Pony 工作流程。

这个工作流程有很多不错的功能

  1. 从正面提示加载 loras

  2. 正确添加 CivitAI 资源检测的元数据

  3. ComfyUI 替代 Highres 修复

  4. ComfyUI 替代“Adetailer”

理论上，您不需要了解此流程的工作原理，您只需使用它即可，但如果您有疑问，请告诉我！

这不是关于如何设置 ComfyUI 的教程（那里有很多教程）。

注意：Pony 工作流程禁用了所有 Highres 和 Adetailer 功能，因为您在 Pony 中并不真正需要它们。可以重新启用，但您可能需要根据SD1.5工作流程中的节点重新构建它。

这个工作流程是我的完整工作流程，因此它包含“Adetailer”节点和一堆其他随机的有用/无用节点。

如果您想要有关如何使用“Adetailer”节点的教程，请访问此处：

https://civitai.com/models/364333/comfyui-face-eyes-and-lips-adetailer-flow-tutorial

安装要求

1.ComfyUI-管理器-https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Manager

2. 待办事项

o.en:
CivitAI removes the metadata of images that contains workflows so I decided I'd post my SD1.5 and Pony workflows.

This workflow has multiple nice features

  1. Loading loras from the positive prompt

  2. Correctly adding metadata for CivitAI resource detection

  3. ComfyUI's replacement for Highres fix

  4. ComfyUI's replacement for "Adetailer"

Theoretically you don't need to understand how this flow works you can just use it but let me know if you have questions!

This isn't a tutorial on how to setup ComfyUI (there are plenty of tutorials out there).

Note: The Pony Workflow has all the Highres and Adetailer stuff disabled because you dont really need it in Pony. It can be reenabled but you may need to rebuilt it based on the nodes in the SD1.5 work flow.

This workflow is my full workflow so it contains "Adetailer" nodes and a bunch of other random useful/useless nodes.

If you want a tutorial on how to use the "Adetailer" nodes please go here:

https://civitai.com/models/364333/comfyui-face-eyes-and-lips-adetailer-flow-tutorial

Install Requirements

1. ComfyUI-Manager -https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Manager
